name: Tinker - Arcology
description: (Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, build, modify, and construct technology for creating and maintaining Arcologies, self-sufficient megastructures housing people as self-contained cities. Includes construction drones, self-recycling soil, maintenance robots, surveillance, farming, recyclers, and all else needed for function. Such technology only works when creating or inside an Arcology.
